produces.note: comma-separated resource tags this animal yields while alive when mature (e.g. 'milk', 'eggs', 'wool'); empty string if none

gender.note: male, female, or unspecified (equipment items also use unspecified)

temperament.note: passive, aggressive, territorial, or none (equipment items)

same_sex_aggression.note: true if this animal fights/is hostile toward other males of the same species (e.g. billy goats, roosters) - relevant for pasture/pen management
